courses.title: Frontend Development
courses.description: Learn how to build modern, responsive websites and web apps from scratch.

content.content: This lesson introduces what a computer is, basic hardware components like CPU, memory, and storage, and how they work together with software.
The internet is a global network that connects millions of devices. You'll learn about IP addresses, DNS, data packets, and how browsers request and display web pages.

questions.question: Which device connects a local network to the internet?

content.content: HTML is the structure of web pages. You’ll learn about elements, attributes, headings, paragraphs, links, images, forms, and semantic tags.
CSS is used to style HTML. Topics include selectors, colors, fonts, margins, padding, and layout techniques like Flexbox and Grid.

content.instructions: Create a personal portfolio website with Home, About, and Contact pages. Use CSS for styling and ensure it is mobile responsive.

content.content: JavaScript enables interactivity in web pages. Learn about variables, data types, operators, loops, functions, and DOM manipulation.
React is a JavaScript library for building interfaces. You'll learn about components, props, state, and JSX syntax.

content.instructions: Build a Todo app where users can add, mark complete, and delete tasks. Use React components and state.
Combine HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build a polished portfolio site with at least 3 projects showcased.

content.content: Learn how to deploy your website using Netlify. Steps include connecting GitHub, setting build commands, and publishing.

courses.title: Data Science
courses.description: Master the skills to analyze data, build models, and derive insights.

content.content: Learn the basics of Python: variables, loops, conditionals, and simple data structures like lists.

questions.question: Which keyword is used to define a function in Python?
What is the output of: print(2 * 3)?

content.content: Lists store ordered data; dictionaries store key-value pairs. Learn how to create, update, and loop through them.
Pandas is a Python library for working with structured data. Learn about DataFrames, filtering, and basic analysis.
Supervised learning uses labeled data to train models. Unsupervised learning finds hidden patterns in unlabeled data.

content.instructions: Use scikit-learn to train a model that predicts housing prices based on features like size and location.
Clean and analyze a dataset, then build a regression model to predict housing prices. Present your findings.

courses.title: Physics Fundamentals
courses.description: Explore the principles of classical and modern physics.

content.content: An object remains at rest, or in uniform motion, unless acted upon by a force. Learn real-world examples of inertia.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of force?

content.content: Force equals mass times acceleration (F = ma). This law explains how forces affect motion.
Interactive simulation showing how forces cause acceleration and motion.
Explore wave-particle duality, uncertainty principle, and quantum states.
Learn how light and particles behave like waves, producing interference patterns.

content.lesson: Build a Physics Simulation with Python
content.instructions: Write a Python program that simulates motion using Newton’s laws.

courses.title: Calculus I
courses.description: Develop a strong foundation in calculus concepts and applications.

content.content: Before starting calculus, review algebra concepts: functions, exponents, and equations.

questions.question: What is the slope of y = 3x + 2?

content.content: Limits form the foundation of calculus. Learn how functions behave as inputs approach a value.
Learn how to compute derivatives from first principles using limits.
See how derivatives are used in velocity, optimization, and growth/decay models.

content.instructions: Solve real-world optimization problems, such as maximizing area or minimizing cost.
Work through a set of applied calculus problems and present your solutions.

courses.title: Cybersecurity Basics
courses.description: Learn to secure networks, applications, and digital information.

content.content: Learn version control basics: initializing a repository, committing changes, branching, and pushing to GitHub.

questions.question: Which command is used to clone a repository?

content.content: Learn how devices connect through LANs, WANs, and the internet. Topics include IP, routers, and switches.
Understand the 7 layers of the OSI model and how data flows through each layer.
Wireshark is a network protocol analyzer. Learn how to capture and inspect packets.
An introduction to ethical hacking, common vulnerabilities, and penetration testing methodology.

content.lesson: Perform a Security Audit on a Sample App
content.instructions: Audit a sample application for vulnerabilities, document issues, and suggest fixes.
